message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data or configuration values anywhere in the visible code.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths defined in configs.py; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-sample filtering applied to the training data anywhere in the visible pipeline code.

No detected model integrity verification: The config specifies a checkpoint path (testing_model) and pretrained=False is set, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading weights; no integrity verification is performed before loading any model file.
No detected label distribution validation: No code in the pipeline checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or any DP mechanism is imported or used in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or FGSM/PGD attack generation anywhere in the evaluation code path.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate val and test loaders exist, there is no isolation enforcement (e.g., signed/hashed data), no evidence the test set is fully held out from training decisions, and only a single evaluation run is performed with no cross-validation or independent metric verification.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads data via get_loaders and passes it directly to model.test() with no input shape, range, or schema validation checks visible in the code.

No detected output bounds checks: The model.test() call is invoked without any post-processing guards such as NaN checks, probability bounds validation, or calibrated threshold enforcement visible in this code slice.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a histology image classification model (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
